trivia_fact: Cloud Run is Google's managed serverless container platform, built on the open-source Knative project that Google co-created. It lets you run any container that listens on a port, bridging the gap between serverless functions and full Kubernetes.

Firebase started as a startup building a real-time chat API called Envolve. When developers started using the real-time backend for non-chat purposes, the founders pivoted to a general-purpose real-time database. Google acquired Firebase in 2014.
